_readme: Flip enabled to true on show night and fill embed_url. Banner appears site-wide only while enabled AND now is inside [show_start, show_end]. embed_url = the iframe src (YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/embed/<VIDEO_ID>?autoplay=1 ; Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/plugins/video.php?href=<urlencoded video url>&show_text=false&autoplay=true). watch_url = plain link used as the fallback 'open in new tab' link.
banner_text: Dancing with the Shasta Stars is LIVE tonight
modal_title: Dancing with the Shasta Stars: Live
